description: This source file defines the PersonService interface for the OpenMRS platform, containing method signatures related to managing Person entities, relationships, attributes, and related data operations within the healthcare data system.

classes.name: PersonService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing Person entities, relationships, attributes, and related system operations in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setPersonDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object (DAO) for person-related database operations.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople
methods.description: Finds and returns a set of persons similar to given criteria based on loose matching of name, birth year, and gender.

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Person objects matching the search phrase, optionally filtering by dead/alive status.

methods.name: savePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Saves a PersonAttributeType to the database, updating global properties as necessary.

methods.name: retirePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Marks a PersonAttributeType as retired with a specified reason.

methods.name: unretirePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Restores a previously retired PersonAttributeType.

methods.name: purgePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a PersonAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: unvoidPerson
methods.description: Unvoids a Person, making it active again in the system.

methods.name: getAllPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all PersonAttributeTypes, including retired ones.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves PersonAttributeTypes matching specified criteria, including whether they are searchable.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its internal ID.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves a Relationship by its internal ID.

methods.name: getRelationshipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Relationship by UUID.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Returns all relationships, including voided ones if specified.

methods.name: getRelationshipsByPerson
methods.description: Retrieves unvoided relationships involving the specified person.

methods.name: getRelationshipsByPerson with Date
methods.description: Retrieves relationships involving the person that were active on a specific date.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves relationships matching fromPerson, toPerson, and relationship type.

methods.name: saveRelationship
methods.description: Creates or updates a relationship between persons.

methods.name: purgeRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a relationship from the database.

methods.name: voidRelationship
methods.description: Voids (deletes logically) a relationship with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidRelationship
methods.description: Unvoids a previously voided relationship.

methods.name: savePerson
methods.description: Creates or updates a Person in the database.

methods.name: purgePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person from the database.

methods.name: getPersonByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Person by UUID.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Retrieves a Person by internal ID.

methods.name: saveRelationshipType
methods.description: Creates or updates a RelationshipType.

methods.name: purgeRelationshipType
methods.description: Deletes a RelationshipType from the database.

methods.name: getAllRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Returns all RelationshipTypes, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllRelationshipTypes with includeRetired
methods.description: Returns RelationshipTypes, optionally including retired types.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Retrieves a RelationshipType by internal ID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a RelationshipType by UUID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a RelationshipType by its name.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Returns RelationshipTypes matching the search string.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypes with name and preferred
methods.description: Returns RelationshipTypes matching name and preferred status.

methods.name: savePersonMergeLog
methods.description: Saves a PersonMergeLog object after serializing data.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonMergeLog by UUID, with optional deserialization.

methods.name: getAllPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves all PersonMergeLogs, with optional deserialization.

methods.name: getWinningPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs where the specified person was the winner in a merge.

methods.name: getLosingPersonMergeLog
methods.description: Retrieves the merge log where the specified person was the loser.

methods.name: voidPersonName
methods.description: Voids a PersonName.

methods.name: unvoidPersonName
methods.description: Unvoids a previously voided PersonName.

methods.name: savePersonName
methods.description: Creates or updates a PersonName.

methods.name: parsePersonName
methods.description: Parses a name string into a PersonName object.

methods.name: getRelationshipMap
methods.description: Builds a map of relationships of a specific type between persons.

methods.name: savePersonAddress
methods.description: Creates or updates a PersonAddress.

methods.name: voidPersonAddress
methods.description: Voids a PersonAddress.

methods.name: unvoidPersonAddress
methods.description: Unvoids a PersonAddress.

methods.name: checkIfPersonAttributeTypesAreLocked
methods.description: Checks whether person attribute types are locked and throws exception if so.
